interpretation_rules: UNKNOWN is not safe and INCONCLUSIVE is not a negative score.
D1P-41 and D1P-43 are separate versioned experiments with different analyzer assumptions and denominators.
D1P-34, D1P-42, and D2-01 benchmark counts are separate tool versions and are not pooled or treated as a trend.
Historical and injected E4 evidence is not relabeled as validation of current warnings, automated discovery, or independent transfer.
Construction, smoke, and mechanical fixture results are not score rows and do not establish security, novelty, or capability.
Mechanical ESTABLISHED and MISMATCH_CANDIDATE states are internal interface outcomes; the effective research result remains UNKNOWN without reviewed policy and eligible facts.
Unsupported analysis, silence, a passing fuzz campaign, and a matching control are not safety evidence.
A MAY, over-approximated, annotated, assumed, or unresolved producer relation cannot discharge a MUST authorization obligation.
Independent evidence requires a frozen supported run with separated access and human triage; no such result exists in the current record.
The three PDF-only reviews identify predominantly missing evidence, not a contradiction of the status manuscript's UNKNOWN/INCONCLUSIVE disposition.
D2-01 support coverage is 17/30 (56.7%) and unsupported/UNKNOWN is 13/30 (43.3%); all supported detections are from WarpToad, so current supported results span one effective lineage.
The 26 warning objects include 23 matched/associated and three unassociated objects; neither 23/26 nor 17/30 is an accuracy estimate.
Step 19's four-profile same-host PASS strengthens byte and selected categorical reproducibility only; it is not semantic validation, clean-machine portability, or independent human replication.
